disclosure: This is the second reporting run (Owner decision D-65, 27 Nov 2026). The first run (commit d20fb82; research/v2/reporting_results.json and reporting_report.md, kept on record with a defect warning) was defective on the detector path: S5 looked up object states by the stitched identity's ID (sti_), while S4 object states keep their track IDs (trk_), so on 0 of 19,750 detector-path pair-frames did it find either object's state; M was unknown on every frame, R4 had no speeds, and R5 and the contact cue had no input (CR-042).

The fix (CR-042 reading 1): on stitched identities M, R4, R5 and the contact cue read each member track's stored S4 state for its own frames; nothing is combined or recomputed across a stitch gap. S4 and every frozen v2 value and configuration are unchanged.
The oracle-path (column A) and full_camera (column B) numbers of the first run, which the defect did not affect, were seen before this re-run, as were the defective detector-path numbers.
